scope: Independent read-only capability audit; no production mutation or speech synthesis

findings.observed: Official Supertonic3 model card declares English en and local ONNX inference. Sherpa's English example explicitly uses the exact Lumo-pinned int8-2026-05-11 bundle and seven component filenames.

Official Java Languages.AVAILABLE accepts en and de; UnicodeProcessor.preprocessText wraps the normalized text with <en>...</en> or <de>...</de>. Language is a separate String argument, not a style or speaker ID. No en-US/en-GB entry in the inspected supported-language list.
tts.json, unicode_indexer.bin, voice.bin and official F2.json retrieved from fixed HF commits all equal the Host2e20 configured SHA256 pins.
Both official F2 style tensors, 12800+128 float32 values, match exactly and uniquely speaker index1 of the pinned ten-speaker voice.bin. Language does not select a different voice vector.

The pinned 65536-entry indexer accepts the reference language markup and all14 current NativeEnglishVocabulary words/phrases after simple period punctuation. This is encoding evidence, not a speech-quality claim.

The converter English HTML has a24000Hz summary, but the exact pinned tts.json reports44100 and agrees with config, Engine, Dart validation and historical audio-production manifest. Preserve44100; do not adopt the contradictory documentation summary.

LumoOfflineSpeechEngine.synthesize(text,style,cancelled) invokes prepareGerman only. Bridge accepts no language and returns de. Dart client accepts only de/profile/F2/44100/local replies; LumoVoice.selectedLocale is de-DE. Native LumoLearningSpeech request uses id/text/style and calls the same German path.

Native learning voice requires learning game, enabled voice, accepted local model license and selected freeOffline identity; inactive/destroyed Activity and changed generation reject stale playback. Automatic reading additionally respects autoRead and calmMode. Local license assent is separate from OS microphone or cloud permission.

Build preparation downloads pinned public weights and embeds model/license assets plus ONNXRuntime1.23.1. Runtime copies/hash-verifies bundled assets to noBackupFilesDir and performs CPU ONNX inference. This speech path has no network/microphone/systemTTS call, despite the wider app manifest declaring INTERNET and RECORD_AUDIO for other features.

minimal_change_constraints: Keep existing German public signature, profile, preset, byte pins, sample rate, license assent and selected-voice semantics.
A narrowly typed internal en/de overload can use the same F2 model; infer the English cue from the validated current lesson, not a free caller-supplied locale or arbitrary tag.
Apply Verb→Werb only in the German branch, never to English text.
Preserve bounded text/output, cancellation, Activity generation, audio/envelope identity and single-player lifecycle when combining sequential English cue and German explanation.
Do not claim en-US/en-GB dialect, an English accent quality, pronunciation acceptance or Android offline synthesis until actual bounded synthesis and listening are separately observed.
notes: Raw metadata/style copies remain local with exact immutable public URLs and hashes; no large model bundle or ONNX weights were downloaded.
The original audio-production manifest is historical German-production evidence, read only to cross-check F2/pins/44100; none of its synthesis results is relabeled as current English synthesis.
